objective: Pursue one paid caption-core feasibility milestone for an in-house short-video editing service without claiming unverified Hebrew, RTL, large-upload, or production-scale capability.

source_need.title: Senior Video-Pipeline Engineer — Build an AI Short-Video Editing Service
source_need.contract: Hourly, expert, more than 30 hours per week, three to six months, paid per accepted milestone
source_need.activity: fewer than five proposals; zero interviewing; zero invites; client last viewed five days before verification
source_need.client_evidence: Member since 2020; USD 488 total spend; seven hires; one active contract
source_need.requested_first_priority: Fast Hebrew captions with word timing, correct RTL and bidirectional rendering, approximately ten supplied styles, silence pacing, and optional repeated-take removal.
source_need.requested_integration: A drop-in asynchronous REST service with webhook delivery, resumable mobile uploads and URL ingestion, queue and monitoring, cloud deployment, and 1080x1920 MP4 output.

supported_now: Python and Tornado API-first video workflow
Speech transcription and timed subtitle processing
Multilingual subtitle correction, translation, and burn-in
Upload, media-serving, process-status, preview, and publishing-queue paths
Project-owned vertical-video examples suitable as workflow evidence
not_proven: Fast conversational Hebrew accuracy or word alignment
Correct Hebrew and Arabic RTL or bidirectional mixed-script caption rendering
Resumable or multipart uploads for files of two gigabytes or more
Drop-in compatibility with the buyer's private POST /projects and webhook contract
Repeated-take removal, punch-in zoom, B-roll selection, or face-centered reframing at the requested scale
Minutes-level production throughput or the buyer's ten-video blind acceptance test

recommended_first_milestone.scope: A paid caption-core feasibility and contract-mapping milestone using a small buyer-supplied representative set: map the private API contract, test Hebrew and mixed-direction caption risks, render one supplied caption style, choose the resumable-upload boundary, and report measured gaps before committing to the blind ten-video acceptance stage.
recommended_first_milestone.price: not proposed until the live listing, rate, source set, acceptance criteria, freelancer fee, and account state are reviewed
recommended_first_milestone.policy: Present this as risk reduction by an adjacent-system builder, not as an already complete Hebrew or production service. Keep contract, communication, files, and payment on Upwork.

remaining_review: Confirm the listing is still open and unchanged
Inspect the visible Connects cost and freelancer fee after login
Confirm an honest hourly rate and 30-plus-hour availability
Review the client's low historical spend and milestone acceptance language
Confirm the first paid feasibility milestone with the buyer before promising the full pipeline
channel.policy: Do not contact the buyer outside Upwork, claim portfolio results that are not public, or imply that a public listing is a qualified lead.
